name: Quick Checkout Button For WooCommerce (Direct Checkout, Checkout, woocommerce quick buy, woocommerce direct checkout)
author: Techplnt

sections.description:
Quick Checkout Button – Streamline Your WooCommerce Direct Checkout Process
The Quick Checkout Button plugin is the ultimate solution for WooCommerce store owners looking to simplify and accelerate the ecommerce checkout experience. Designed to reduce cart abandonment and boost conversions, this plugin adds a seamless, one-click Direct Checkout button to your WooCommerce store, allowing customers to bypass the traditional cart page and proceed directly to payment.

🔹Key Features:
✔️ One-Click Quick Checkout: Enable a Direct Checkout button that takes customers straight to payment, saving time and reducing friction.
✔️ Customizable Button: Tailor the button’s text, color, and style to match your store’s branding.
✔ ️ Mobile-Friendly: Optimized for all devices, ensuring a smooth WooCommerce One Page Checkout experience on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
✔ ️ Improved Conversion Rates: Reduce cart abandonment by simplifying the ecommerce checkout process.
✔️ Easy Setup: Install and configure in minutes with no coding required.
✔️ Compatible with WooCommerce: Works seamlessly with your existing WooCommerce setup, including WooCommerce Quick Buy functionality.

✨Free Features:

✅ Add quick checkout buttons to shop/archive pages
✅ Add quick checkout buttons to single product pages
✅ Support for simple, variable, and grouped products
✅ Responsive design that works on all devices
⚡ AJAX-powered for smooth user experience
🌍 Translation ready
🚀 No configuration needed – works out of the box
🎨 Compatible with most WooCommerce themes

🔹How it works:

  1. Customer clicks the “Click to Checkout” button
  2. Product is automatically added to cart
  3. Customer is redirected to checkout page
  4. Purchase process is completed faster

Perfect for stores wanting to reduce cart abandonment and simplify the buying process.

Why Choose Quick Checkout Button?

In today’s fast-paced ecommerce world, every second counts. The Quick Checkout Button plugin helps you provide a hassle-free shopping experience, encouraging customers to complete their purchases quickly and efficiently. Whether you’re running a small online store or a high-traffic eCommerce platform, this plugin is a must-have tool to enhance user experience and drive sales.

Download Now and Transform Your Checkout Experience!

Download the Quick Checkout Button today and take the first step toward a faster, more efficient WooCommerce Direct Checkout process! Boost your ecommerce sales with WooCommerce Quick Buy and One Page Checkout functionality – all in one powerful plugin!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quick-checkout-button directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. The quick checkout buttons will appear automatically on your shop and product pages
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes! For variable products, customers will need to select their options first, then the quick checkout button becomes active.

Will this empty my cart?

By default, yes. The plugin clears the cart before adding the selected product to ensure a clean checkout experience. This can be modified in the code if needed.

Is it compatible with my theme?

The plugin is designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. If you experience styling issues, you may need to add custom CSS.

Can I customize the button appearance?

Yes, you can add custom CSS to override the default button styling. The button uses the class .quick-checkout-btn.
